sentence: If she had studied harder, she ______ the exam. (third conditional)
explanation: Resultado del tercer condicional: <would have> + participio pasado.

sentence: I wish I ______ more time to travel. (wish + past)
explanation: Después de <wish>, se usa el pasado simple para expresar deseos irreales en el presente.

sentence: She had her car ______ at the garage. (causative)
explanation: Causativo <have something done>: have + objeto + participio pasado.

sentence: Not only ______ she speak French, but she also speaks Italian. (inversion)
explanation: Después de <Not only> al inicio de la oración, se usa orden inverso: <does she>.

sentence: It was the manager ______ made the final decision. (cleft sentence)
explanation: Oración hendida: <It was... who/that> enfatiza el sujeto.

sentence: The project fell ______ because of lack of funding. (phrasal verb: fail)
explanation: El phrasal verb <fall through> significa no llegar a ocurrir según lo planeado.

sentence: We need to iron ______ the remaining issues before launch.
explanation: El phrasal verb <iron out> significa resolver problemas o dificultades.

sentence: She ______ up with a brilliant idea during the meeting.
explanation: El phrasal verb <come up with> significa idear o producir una idea.

sentence: He ______ down the job offer because of the low salary.
explanation: El phrasal verb <turn down> significa rechazar o negarse.

sentence: The company is phasing ______ the old software gradually.
explanation: El phrasal verb <phase out> significa eliminar algo gradualmente.

sentence: Don't put all your eggs in one ______. Diversify your investments.
explanation: El modismo <don't put all your eggs in one basket> significa no arriesgarlo todo en una sola opción.

sentence: The elephant in the room is the obvious problem that nobody wants to ______.
explanation: El modismo <the elephant in the room> se refiere a un problema obvio que todos ignoran.

sentence: She's barking up the wrong tree. She's looking in the wrong ______.
explanation: El modismo <barking up the wrong tree> significa seguir un enfoque equivocado.

sentence: He decided to bite the bullet and ______ the difficult conversation.
explanation: El modismo <bite the bullet> significa afrontar algo difícil con valentía.

sentence: That's the last straw. I can't ______ it anymore.
explanation: El modismo <the last straw> significa el último problema que hace que una situación sea insoportable.

sentence: The nominali______ of verbs is common in academic writing.
explanation: Al agregar <-ation> a <nominalize> se forma el sustantivo <nominalization>.

sentence: His reckless______ caused the accident.
explanation: Al agregar <-ness> a <reckless> se forma el sustantivo <recklessness>.

sentence: The prefix 'mis-' in 'misunderstand' means ______.
explanation: El prefijo <mis-> significa incorrectamente o mal: <misunderstand> = entender mal.

sentence: Adding '-ive' to 'create' gives us ______, meaning having the quality of creating.
explanation: El sufijo <-ive> forma adjetivos: <creative> = que tiene la cualidad de crear.

sentence: The prefix 'over-' in 'overestimate' means ______.
explanation: El prefijo <over-> significa demasiado o excesivamente: <overestimate> = sobrestimar.

sentence: If I ______ you, I would accept the offer. (transform: advice using conditional)
explanation: Segundo condicional para dar consejos: <If I were you> (forma subjuntiva).

sentence: The report ______ being prepared when the power went out. (transform to passive continuous)
explanation: Pasado continuo en voz pasiva: <was being> + participio pasado.

sentence: Had I ______ about the delay, I would have left earlier. (inverted conditional)
explanation: Tercer condicional invertido: <Had I known> = If I had known.

sentence: It ______ that the company will announce layoffs. (transform: 'People say the company...' → impersonal passive)
explanation: Voz pasiva impersonal: <It is said that...> reporta creencias generales.

sentence: She ______ to have left the country. (transform: 'People believe she left' → passive report)
explanation: Reporte en voz pasiva: sujeto + <is believed> + to have + participio pasado.
